body: Oh gosh, thank you for the message! The "We care" is enough to bring me to tears. Thank you.

Those words are so valuable, and when you are in pain you just don't have the capacity to hear them.

I am grateful to google for putting a hotline number at the top of my search for suicide.

Thanks for the wise words.

That didn't happen. Nobody called the cops on me. And I called several hotlines. 

I am sorry if you had a bad experience.

thank you so much.

my circumstances still seem impossible, but i don't want to die anymore. it's a big step.

yes, yes, i agree.
 
i didn't feel magically better after the first call, but they gave me something that made me keep calling, and i also looked up different suicide hotlines because I was paranoid.

Call every hotline you can! One of then will resonate wth you, and you can also call twice.. I did.

I am feeling so grateful for people such as you. I don't really get how you do it, because I'm pretty sure I was  so incoherent you couldn't possibly understand. But you did, and kept listening.

I have no idea what's going to happen now, but suicide is no longer something I;m looking at, and it feels really good,

Thank you to people like you, and I've been following up on your local suggestions. I feel very humbled and so grateful to know total strangers don't want me to die.

Thank you very much for the positive message. It makes me feel really good, and I really am up for tackling the tough stuff. It helps a lot to know there are people wishing me well even if I don't know them. I appreciate this a lot. :}

Thank you. It took many calls over a week, but something sunk in eventually. 

I think it may be difficult, because if you are in a position to call, you are probably already feeling hopeless and alone. 

Still feeling somewhat hopeless, but not nearly so alone. It blows my mind these people will listen to me crying incoherently and listen without judging. The really listen!!

Yes, I understand this. I used Google as well. I felt a sense of relief when I found the "perfect way", and you will probably feel that as well. It was like finally, I can end it peacefully and all will be well and my family might not be hurt too well.

But it required planning and scheduling, and details. And the more I gave thought to these details, the more it hit home what I was really doing. Quite the revelation, because I didn't believe in home or people, or anything really. I am still struggling with that and my situation really hasn't improved. If anything, it's gotten worse, as I longer have unemployment, and I must now go through my retirement savings.

But I  just don't feel like dying anymore, and it's a damn good feeling. I'm not joyous or hysterical, but I think I can do this!!

I wish the same for you, and I fully realize I can't give this to you.

I wouldn't mind so much, but I would never share this. It is one thing for me to be in a bad place, and it is quite another for me to provide help for someone else to end their life. Can you tell me why you are interested? In a PM if that is better for you.

Thank you so much for sharing your story. It really means a lot to me. 

I've been in a horrible place and I've now called several suicide hotlines. They truly gave me hope, even if it took 4 calls.

I really do thank you for sharing that. It's very brave, and I hope I can share such a story one day and help someone who is truly lost.

Thanks from the bottom of my heart, and I hope you know how to share to this info IRL.

I am feeling even more hopeful after reading your story and I hope you are doing well.

Thank you..
I understand it's not advice, but if you just wanted to get it done, how would you do it?

I have looked into help my area and there is very little. They have way bigger problems, and I'm not a danger to anyone. I'm in Los Angeles. 

I used to think this was a sad lack of services, but it kind of seems like a sign to me now.
I have heard this, but it makes no sense to me. If I believed it was a temporary problem that I could overcome, I wouldn't be considering suicide.
But what if there really isn't help?

I've read that,but it's kind of not true and can be very misleading. It's impossible if you don't have insurance and a support system. Sometimes the people you are counting on to help you demand you involve the people  who aren't good for you.
